say:1:1320301001:1.text: Ah, there you are! I was about to grab Hugin and look for you, haha!
say:1:1320301001:1.source_cn: 你可算是出现了！我正准备拉上呼金那老家伙一起去寻你呢，哈哈。
say:1:1320301001:1.male: Ah, there you are! I was about to grab Hugin and look for you, haha!
say:1:1320301001:1.female: Ah, there you are! I was about to grab Hugin and look for you, haha!

choice_prompt:2:1320301001.text: Ah, there you are! I was about to grab Hugin and look for you, haha!
choice_prompt:2:1320301001.source_cn: 你可算是出现了！我正准备拉上呼金那老家伙一起去寻你呢，哈哈。
choice_prompt:2:1320301001.male: Ah, there you are! I was about to grab Hugin and look for you, haha!
choice_prompt:2:1320301001.female: Ah, there you are! I was about to grab Hugin and look for you, haha!

say:3:1320301002:1.text: I just wanted to let you know that a strange person in town has been looking for you.
say:3:1320301002:1.source_cn: 不是什么大事。就是镇上有个怪家伙一直在找你。
say:3:1320301002:1.male: I just wanted to let you know that a strange person in town has been looking for you.
say:3:1320301002:1.female: I just wanted to let you know that a strange person in town has been looking for you.

say:4:1320301003:1.text: She's wearing a hood, and nobody knows where she lives. I saw a few kids get scared stiff, so I thought I'd ask what she was up to.
say:4:1320301003:1.source_cn: 那人戴着兜帽，神出鬼没的。我瞧好几个小孩都被吓傻了，就...
say:4:1320301003:1.male: She's wearing a hood, and nobody knows where she lives. I saw a few kids get scared stiff, so I thought I'd ask what she was up to.
say:4:1320301003:1.female: She's wearing a hood, and nobody knows where she lives. I saw a few kids get scared stiff, so I thought I'd ask what she was up to.

say:5:1320301004:1.text: She didn't say much—just told me to pass along a message: she'll be waiting for you on the road east of town.
say:5:1320301004:1.source_cn: 不过她什么也没说，就让我传个口信给你，说会在镇外东边的...
say:5:1320301004:1.male: She didn't say much—just told me to pass along a message: she'll be waiting for you on the road east of town.
say:5:1320301004:1.female: She didn't say much—just told me to pass along a message: she'll be waiting for you on the road east of town.

say:6:1320301005:1.text: I couldn't make out her face, but she sounded like a woman. She's not someone out to get you, is she?
say:6:1320301005:1.source_cn: 我没看清那人的脸，但听声音是个女人。应该不是你的仇人吧？
say:6:1320301005:1.male: I couldn't make out her face, but she sounded like a woman. She's not someone out to get you, is she?
say:6:1320301005:1.female: I couldn't make out her face, but she sounded like a woman. She's not someone out to get you, is she?

say:8:1320301006:1.text: Of course not! The master is so kind; there's no way he'd have enemies!
say:8:1320301006:1.source_cn: 当然不是！主人这么友善，怎么可能和人结仇！
say:8:1320301006:1.male: Of course not! The master is so kind; there's no way he'd have enemies!
say:8:1320301006:1.female: Of course not! The master is so kind; there's no way she'd have enemies!

say:10:1320301008:1.text: You should probably hurry over. If you're late, who knows if she'll still be there.
say:10:1320301008:1.source_cn: 你们赶紧过去吧。要是去晚了，那人说不准就走了。

choice:2:0:1.text: What can I do for you?
choice:2:0:1.male: What can I do for you?
choice:2:0:1.female: What can I do for you?

say:0:1320302001:0.text: The person he just mentioned must be Valka, right?
say:0:1320302001:0.source_cn: 神出鬼没，戴着兜帽的女人……应该是瓦丽卡吧。

say:1:1320302002:0.text: I wonder what she might need from the magister this time.
say:1:1320302002:0.source_cn: 不知道她这次找主人有什么事。
say:1:1320302002:0.male: I wonder what she might need from the magister this time.
say:1:1320302002:0.female: I wonder what she might need from the magister this time.

say:0:1320303001:0.text: Oh, it was Valka after all!

say:2:1320304001:1.text: Valka, what brings you all the way to Cedartown? Did you run into any trouble?
say:2:1320304001:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你怎么特意跑来雪松镇，难道是遇见什么棘手的事了吗？

say:3:1320304002:1.text: Don't worry, it's not that serious.

say:4:1320304003:2.text: I'm here on behalf of Ludovic; he asked me to help find a painter.
say:4:1320304003:2.source_cn: 我是替柳博米尔来的，他请我帮忙找一位画家。

say:5:1320304004:1.text: As I'm unacquainted with the locals of Cedartown, I can hardly go about openly asking questions. Moreover, appearing as a Graveborn poses certain challenges.
say:5:1320304004:1.source_cn: 但是顶着活死人的身份，做什么都不方便。即使是我，对雪松...

say:6:1320304005:1.text: Thus, I would greatly appreciate your help.

say:7:1320304006:1.text: I posed the same question to Ludovic, yet he appears unaware of the painter's name as well.
say:7:1320304006:1.source_cn: 我也这样问柳博米尔，但他也不知道对方的名字。
say:7:1320304006:1.male: I posed the same question to Ludovic, yet he appears unaware of the painter's name as well.
say:7:1320304006:1.female: I posed the same question to Ludovic, yet he appears unaware of the painter's name as well.

say:8:1320304007:1.text: If Ludovic and I were to reveal ourselves, it would likely only instill fear in the people there.
say:8:1320304007:1.source_cn: 总好过我和柳博米尔出面，那样只会吓到雪松镇里的人。
say:8:1320304007:1.male: If Ludovic and I were to reveal ourselves, it would likely only instill fear in the people there.
say:8:1320304007:1.female: If Ludovic and I were to reveal ourselves, it would likely only instill fear in the people there.

say:9:1320304008:1.text: As for the details, once we arrive at Everstill Manor, Ludovic will tell you everything himself.
say:9:1320304008:1.source_cn: 具体的情况，等到了永寂庄园，让柳博米尔自己和你说吧。
say:9:1320304008:1.male: As for the details, once we arrive at Everstill Manor, Ludovic will tell you everything himself.
say:9:1320304008:1.female: As for the details, once we arrive at Everstill Manor, Ludovic will tell you everything himself.

say:3:1320306001:1.text: Pardon me for the sudden invite, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:3:1320306001:1.male: Pardon me for the sudden invite, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:3:1320306001:1.female: Pardon me for the sudden invite, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:4:1320306002:1.text: Valka mentioned that you're looking for a painter. Do you have any details on them?
say:4:1320306002:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡说你想找一位画家，对方是谁呀？

say:5:1320306003:1.text: Please take a look at this painting first.

say:8:1320306007:2.text: So... is the artist of this painting the person you're looking for?
say:8:1320306007:2.source_cn: 这幅画的作者，就是你想找的那个人吗？

say:10:1320306009:1.text: This painting displays remarkable technique and has a vibrant spirit. The artist's ability to capture the atmosphere with just a few strokes speaks to their incredible potential.
say:10:1320306009:1.source_cn: 在我看来，这幅画画技高超，充满灵气。能用寥寥几笔就完成...

say:11:1320306010:1.text: It's a pity the painting remains unfinished; the damage leaves me wondering about its story.
say:11:1320306010:1.source_cn: 只可惜这幅画没有完成，也不知遭遇过什么，竟然破损至此…...

say:12:1320306011:1.text: Unfortunately, I've been living in seclusion for so long that I hardly know any humans. I can only rely on Valka to seek your assistance.
say:12:1320306011:1.source_cn: 但我一直隐居，认识的人类屈指可数。只能拜托瓦丽卡请你们帮忙。

say:13:1320306012:1.text: Umm... where did you get this painting?
say:13:1320306012:1.source_cn: 唔，那你知道这幅画是哪里来的吗？

say:14:1320306013:1.text: It was delivered to me by a trader who has been providing me with artwork for a long time. I bought it for a very low price.
say:14:1320306013:1.source_cn: 这是一位为我长期提供艺术品的商人送来的，我用很低的价格...

say:15:1320306014:1.text: She calls herself the <style="highlight">Black Crow Trader</style>, one of the few brave enough to enter the Duskmire Forest. As for her real name, I have no idea.

say:16:1320306015:1.text: That's fine. Since you've done business with her, you must have seen her face at least?
say:16:1320306015:1.source_cn: 没关系。既然你和她做生意，总见过她的长相吧？

say:17:1320306016:1.text: Unfortunately, I've never actually met her face-to-face...

say:18:1320306017:1.text: She usually leaves the artwork at a designated spot, and I take them while leaving the payment and a small fee behind.
say:18:1320306017:1.source_cn: 每次交易，都是由她将货物放在约定的地点，我取走时留下购...

say:19:1320306018:1.text: Well... this is tricky since we have no idea what she looks like or what her name is...
say:19:1320306018:1.source_cn: 不知道真名也不知道长相……这下可难办了……

say:20:1320306019:1.text: How about we check their meeting spot to see if there are any clues?
say:20:1320306019:1.source_cn: 要不我们去柳博米尔和黑鸦商人约定的地方看看？说不定对方...

say:21:1320306020:2.text: I'd really appreciate it if you could go take a look. The agreed spot is <style="highlight">beneath a withered tree north of the waterfall</style> in the Duskmire Forest.
say:21:1320306020:2.source_cn: 只能麻烦你们过去看看了。黑沼森林<style=high...

say:24:1320306021:0.text: Is that on the shortcut to the manor?
say:24:1320306021:0.source_cn: 你说的地方是不是在通往庄园的那条近路上？

say:25:1320306022:0.text: If you're willing to trek through the swamp, then yes... that's a shortcut.
say:25:1320306022:0.source_cn: ……如果你愿意蹚过沼泽，那确实是条近路。

say:26:1320306023:0.text: I noticed a human there when I came by; perhaps she was the Black Crow Trader you referred to.
say:26:1320306023:0.source_cn: 我来的时候看到那里有个人类，或许就是你说的黑鸦商人。

say:27:1320306024:0.text: I believe it would be inappropriate for me to engage directly with humans. I will leave this matter in your capable hands, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:27:1320306024:0.source_cn: 和人类打交道的事，恐怕我也不方便出面。<style=s...
say:27:1320306024:0.male: I believe it would be inappropriate for me to engage directly with humans. I will leave this matter in your capable hands, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:27:1320306024:0.female: I believe it would be inappropriate for me to engage directly with humans. I will leave this matter in your capable hands, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:28:1320306025:1.text: Rest assured, we'll definitely find out more about that painter for Ludovic!
say:28:1320306025:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我们一定会帮柳博米尔打听到那位画家的消息！

say:30:1320306005:1.text: Looks like we see things differently.
say:30:1320306005:1.source_cn: 看来我们的想法不太一样。
say:30:1320306005:1.male: Looks like we see things differently.
say:30:1320306005:1.female: Looks like we see things differently.

say:0:1320307001:0.text: The place Ludovic mentioned is right here.
say:0:1320307001:0.source_cn: 柳博米尔说的地方就是这里。

say:1:1320307002:0.text: Could that person be the Black Crow Trader?
say:1:1320307002:0.source_cn: 前面那个人会不会就是黑鸦商人？

say:3:1320308001:1.text: Hey there, are you lost? Do you need help finding your way out? I promise my fees are quite reasonable!
say:3:1320308001:1.source_cn: 几位，你们是不是迷路了？需要我告诉你们离开这里的路吗？...

say:4:1320308002:2.text: Listen to that! That's definitely something a trader would say!
say:4:1320308002:2.source_cn: 哇，果然是商人会说的话！

say:5:1320308003:1.text: Huh?! How did you know I'm a trader?
say:5:1320308003:1.source_cn: 诶？！你怎么会知道我是商人？

choice_prompt:6:1320308003.text: Huh?! How did you know I'm a trader?
choice_prompt:6:1320308003.source_cn: 诶？！你怎么会知道我是商人？

say:7:1320308004:1.text: Are you the one living here and doing business with me?!
say:7:1320308004:1.source_cn: 难不成……你就是那个隐居在这里、和我做生意的人？！

say:8:1320308005:1.text: No, that can't be right... A living human like you can't possibly live in the Duskmire Forest...
say:8:1320308005:1.source_cn: ……不，不对啊。你一个大活人，干嘛隐居在黑沼森林里……

say:9:1320308006:1.text: Hehe, I won't keep you guessing any longer.

say:10:1320308007:1.text: The one buying art from you is our friend. He asked us to check on something for him.
say:10:1320308007:1.source_cn: 从你这里购买艺术品的人并不是我们，而是我们的朋友。他托...

say:11:1320308008:1.text: Oh, I see! You really surprised me there.
say:11:1320308008:1.source_cn: 原来是这样啊，真是吓我一跳呢。

say:12:1320308009:1.text: Go ahead and ask what you need. Considering the generous fee your friend left behind, I won't charge you this time.
say:12:1320308009:1.source_cn: 想问什么，你们尽管说吧。看在那些丰厚的辛苦费的份上，我...

say:13:1320308010:1.text: Do you remember selling him a damaged painting before? He wants to know who the painter is!
say:13:1320308010:1.source_cn: 你还记得之前你卖给他一幅破损的画吗？他想知道那幅画的画...

say:14:1320308011:1.text: A damaged painting...? Can you be more specific?

choice_prompt:15:1320308011.text: A damaged painting...? Can you be more specific?

say:16:1320308012:1.text: Oh, that one! I got it from a banker who said it was a debt repayment from a borrower, so it wasn't worth much, and that's why the price was so low.
say:16:1320308012:1.source_cn: 哦……想起来了。那幅画是我从一位银行家手里收来的，说是...

say:17:1320308013:1.text: As for the painter—hold on, let me check my transaction records.
say:17:1320308013:1.source_cn: 至于画家是谁——等等，让我翻一下我的交易记录。

say:18:1320308014:1.text: Aha! Found it! The painter is a young man named <style="highlight">Levski</style>, and he lives at the <style="highlight">eastern edge of Cedartown</style>.

say:19:1320308015:1.text: Perfect! Let's set off to find Levski now!
say:19:1320308015:1.source_cn: 太好了！我们现在就出发去找列夫斯基吧！

choice:6:0:1.text: I also know you sell artwork.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 我还知道你在这里做艺术品生意
choice:6:0:1.male: I also know you sell artwork.
choice:6:0:1.female: I also know you sell artwork.

choice:6:1:2.text: Are you the Black Crow Trader?
choice:6:1:2.male: Are you the Black Crow Trader?
choice:6:1:2.female: Are you the Black Crow Trader?

choice:6:2:3.text: Why don't you take a wild guess?
choice:6:2:3.male: Why don't you take a wild guess?
choice:6:2:3.female: Why don't you take a wild guess?

say:0:1320310001:0.text: What's with all these people around here...? It sounds like they're talking about Levski!
say:0:1320310001:0.source_cn: 这里怎么围着这么多人……他们好像还提到了列夫斯基！

say:1:1320310002:0.source_cn: 还是先找人问问发生了什么事吧。

say:2:1320311001:1.text: Excuse me, ma'am, is this Levski's home? Why are there so many people here?
say:2:1320311001:1.source_cn: 大婶，请问这里是列夫斯基的家吗？为什么会聚集这么多人？

say:3:1320311002:1.text: You're in the right place. As for the crowd... *Sigh* They're all here to collect debts.
say:3:1320311002:1.source_cn: 没找错，这就是列夫斯基他们家。至于这些人……唉，都是来...

say:4:1320311003:1.text: Isn't Levski a painter? How did he end up in so much debt?
say:4:1320311003:1.source_cn: 列夫斯基不是位画家吗，怎么会欠这么多债？

say:5:1320311004:1.text: It's all because of his illness!
say:5:1320311004:1.source_cn: 还能为什么，都是因为他的病！

say:6:1320311005:1.text: That boy had a real gift for painting and a bright future ahead, but who would've thought he'd suddenly fall seriously ill?
say:6:1320311005:1.source_cn: 那孩子画画很有天赋，本来前途一片光明，谁能想到会突然得...

say:7:1320311006:1.text: To afford his treatment, his father, Evgeny, borrowed from neighbors and even sought loans from merchants and bankers, but that poor boy's condition just keeps getting worse.
say:7:1320311006:1.source_cn: 为了给他治病，他父亲叶甫根尼借遍了左邻右舍，又跑去向商...

say:8:1320311007:1.text: *Sigh* It won't be easy for them to pay off their debts anytime soon...
say:8:1320311007:1.source_cn: 唉，欠了那么多钱，哪是一时半会就能还上的……

say:9:1320311008:1.text: Dura above, I truly hope Levski's family can find their way out of this dark time soon...
say:9:1320311008:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，但愿列夫斯基一家能早日走出阴霾……

say:2:1320312001:1.text: Hey, I've never seen you around before. Are you here to collect debts too?
say:2:1320312001:1.source_cn: 又一张没见过的新面孔。你也是来讨债的？

say:3:1320312002:1.text: Levski has nothing of value left. If the amount he owes you isn't too high, maybe you could extend him some grace.
say:3:1320312002:1.source_cn: 听我一句劝，列夫斯基家已经没有值钱的东西了。要是欠你的...

say:4:1320312003:1.text: We're not here to collect debts!
say:4:1320312003:1.source_cn: 你误会了，我们不是债主！

say:5:1320312004:1.text: But what you just said... is it really true that the Levski family can't pay off their debts at all?
say:5:1320312004:1.source_cn: 不过你刚才说的……列夫斯基家已经完全还不起债了，是真的吗？

say:6:1320312005:1.text: Why would I lie about that?

say:7:1320312006:1.text: They've had plenty of creditors show up before today. Anything of value has long been taken as collateral for their debts—there's nothing left now!
say:7:1320312006:1.source_cn: 在今天这位之前，他们家已经来过不少债主了。但凡是值点钱...

say:8:1320312007:1.text: Even so, more people keep showing up to collect their debts. *Sigh* Who knows when their days of hardship will come to an end...
say:8:1320312007:1.source_cn: 即使这样，还有不少人陆续找上门来讨债。唉，不知道他们家...

say:0:1320313001:0.text: Levski's really had it rough... sick and buried in debt at the same time. Poor him.
say:0:1320313001:0.source_cn: 列夫斯基好惨，先是生了重病，又欠下了这么多钱……

say:1:1320313002:0.text: Let's try talking to this debt collector first. If he doesn't leave, we won't even get a chance to see Levski.
say:1:1320313002:0.source_cn: 先劝一劝这位债主吧。他不走的话，我们根本见不到列夫斯基。

say:3:1320314001:1.text: What do you want?! Can't you see I'm in the middle of collecting a debt? Get lost!
say:3:1320314001:1.source_cn: 找我干嘛？没看见我正忙着催债吗！去去去！

say:4:1320314002:1.text: Pay up, Levski! Evgeny! Get out here and pay up! I know you're in there!!!
say:4:1320314002:1.source_cn: ——还钱！列夫斯基，老叶甫根尼，快出来！我知道你们在家！！

say:5:1320314003:1.text: Quit shouting! Levski is ill and needs rest!
say:5:1320314003:1.source_cn: 别喊了！列夫斯基还在养病呢！

say:6:1320314004:1.text: Seriously, everyone's already said they're broke. What's the point of all this yelling?
say:6:1320314004:1.source_cn: 是啊！而且周围这么多人都说他们家没钱了，你没听到吗？

say:7:1320314005:1.text: Are you their relatives, or just some wannabe heroes trying to play the savior?
say:7:1320314005:1.source_cn: ……你们又是从哪冒出来的？这么替他们说话，是他们的亲戚？

say:8:1320314006:1.text: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.
say:8:1320314006:1.source_cn: 要不然，你替他们把钱还上？只要拿到钱，我立刻就走，绝不废话。
say:8:1320314006:1.male: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.
say:8:1320314006:1.female: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.

choice_prompt:9:1320314006.text: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.
choice_prompt:9:1320314006.source_cn: 要不然，你替他们把钱还上？只要拿到钱，我立刻就走，绝不废话。
choice_prompt:9:1320314006.male: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.
choice_prompt:9:1320314006.female: If you really want to be their savior, just pay their debt! Once I get the money, I'll be out of here without a fuss.

say:10:1320314007:1.text: Then you shouldn't be meddling here!
say:10:1320314007:1.source_cn: 不是亲戚？那你就别在这多管闲事！
say:10:1320314007:1.male: Then you shouldn't be meddling here!

say:0:1320317001:0.male: Thank you for standing up for me...
say:0:1320317001:0.female: Thank you for standing up for me...

say:4:1320318002:1.text: What can I do for you?
say:4:1320318002:1.source_cn: 你们找我……是有什么事吗？

say:5:1320318003:1.text: Our friend bought one of your paintings from a trader, but it arrived damaged...
say:5:1320318003:1.source_cn: 我们的朋友从一位商人手里买下了你创作的一幅画，但那幅画...

say:6:1320318004:1.text: He was quite disappointed and wanted to know what happened to it.
say:6:1320318004:1.source_cn: 那位朋友觉得很可惜，所以想问问你那幅画身上到底发生了什么事。

say:7:1320318005:1.text: We don't know the name of the painting, but the trader said it was given to the banker as a form of debt repayment. Do you remember which one it is?
say:7:1320318005:1.source_cn: 唔，我们不知道那幅画的名字……但听卖画的商人说，它是一...

say:10:1320318007:1.text: Oh, that one... of course I remember.
say:10:1320318007:1.source_cn: 原来是那一幅啊……我记得，我当然记得……

say:11:1320318008:1.text: That was the last painting I created before I became ill; it was my pride and joy, born from a burst of creativity...
say:11:1320318008:1.source_cn: 那幅画，是我生病前创作的最后一幅画，也是我灵感涌现的得...

say:12:1320318009:1.text: When I was working on it, I felt as if Dura was finally favoring me. I used only the best materials for that piece...

say:13:1320318010:1.text: The sturdiest canvas, the finest colors, and the best brushes that felt perfect in my grip...
say:13:1320318010:1.source_cn: 最坚韧的画布，最珍贵的颜料，最顺手的画笔……

say:14:1320318011:1.text: I was convinced that once I finished this painting, I would gain fame and become a master who pioneers a new style...
say:14:1320318011:1.source_cn: 只要完成这幅画作，我一定能名声远扬，成为开创流派的大师……

choice_prompt:16:1320318012.text: But... I didn't manage to complete it before my body collapsed! I could no longer stand or hold the brush; even just breathing drained all my energy... I... I can't... I can't...
choice_prompt:16:1320318012.source_cn: 可是……可是我还没有完成它，身体却突然垮了！我再也站不起来，手拿不住画笔，光是呼吸就用尽了力气……我……我再也不能……！

say:18:1320318017:1.text: The painting... was taken as debt repayment by my creditors.
say:18:1320318017:1.source_cn: 没错，那幅画……被我家的债主抢走抵债了。

say:19:1320318018:1.text: Those traders and bankers... only care about its value. They can't appreciate the true beauty of art.
say:19:1320318018:1.source_cn: 那些人……无论是商人，还是银行家……他们只在乎画的价值...

say:20:1320318019:1.text: They tossed the painting into a pile of junk during their scuffle, and that's how it ended up damaged...
say:20:1320318019:1.source_cn: 在他们争抢的过程中，那幅画……被甩到了杂物堆里，才破损...

say:21:1320318020:1.text: You must be devastated to see your work ruined...
say:21:1320318020:1.source_cn: 居然是这样……看到那幅画被毁，你一定很心痛。

say:22:1320318021:1.text: Yes, it was my final masterpiece...
say:22:1320318021:1.source_cn: 是啊，它是我最后的心血了……

say:23:1320318022:1.text: Don't worry; our friend greatly admires your painting! He'll make sure it's well cared for!
say:23:1320318022:1.source_cn: 别担心，我们那位朋友很欣赏你的这幅画！肯定会好好保存它的！

say:24:1320318023:1.text: That's wonderful to hear... It's good to know that someone truly values my work...
say:24:1320318023:1.source_cn: 是吗，那就好……有人欣赏它就好……

say:25:1320318024:1.text: Please convey my thanks to the buyer. It means so much to me that he values my work...
say:25:1320318024:1.source_cn: 麻烦你们，替我向那位买家问好。谢谢他……能欣赏我的心血。

say:27:1320318014:1.text: Everyone tells me that. I truly hope... to recover so I can finally hold my brush once more...
say:27:1320318014:1.source_cn: ……每个人都这样说。但愿……但愿真的可以。

choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 好好养病，一定可以康复的

choice:16:2:3.male: Tell me, why was the painting ruined?
choice:16:2:3.female: Tell me, why was the painting ruined?

say:3:1320319001:1.text: I can tell from your faces that you've found the painter.

choice_prompt:4:1320319001.text: I can tell from your faces that you've found the painter.

say:7:1320319004:1.source_cn: 身染重疾的艺术家，未完成的画作……呵。

say:11:1320319009:1.text: I have one more favor to ask. I'd like to restore this painting, but I may need some special materials.

say:12:1320319010:2.text: If it's just about fixing the canvas, magic would work perfectly!
say:12:1320319010:2.source_cn: 如果只是修复破损的话，完全可以用魔法呀！

say:16:1320319013:1.text: The passage of time is what truly honors great artwork.
say:16:1320319013:1.source_cn: 艺术不该是这样的东西。流逝的时间，才是它的见证者。

say:17:1320319014:1.text: Let's go see how we can restore it.
say:17:1320319014:1.source_cn: 走吧。让我们看看该怎样修复它。

say:19:1320319006:2.text: I remember you saying that your parents used to decorate the manor with your paintings...
say:19:1320319006:2.source_cn: 我记得，之前你曾经提过……你父母曾经在庄园里挂满了你的画作。

say:20:1320319007:1.text: Wait... are you implying that the similar story is your own?
say:20:1320319007:1.source_cn: 难道……你说的人就是你自己吗？

choice:9:1:2.female: Have you met someone like that?

say:5:1320320003:1.source_cn: ——画布早就被整理平整了，那些就是脏污呀！

say:6:1320320004:0.source_cn: 除了这些，最严重的是画面磨损。尤其是在被撕裂的裂口两边。

say:9:1320320007:1.text: Where can we find those materials?
say:9:1320320007:1.source_cn: 那我们该上哪找这些材料呢？

say:0:1320321001:0.text: Ludovic, can you really make paint just with the dust from the oculus bats?
say:0:1320321001:0.source_cn: 柳博米尔，只用目蝠翅膀上的菌丝粉就能制成颜料吗？

say:1:1320321002:0.text: No, it only serves to enhance the paint's opacity.
say:1:1320321002:0.source_cn: 不，它的功能只是增强颜料的遮盖力。

say:0:1320322001:0.text: Look, there's an oculus bat right here.
say:0:1320322001:0.source_cn: 看到目蝠了吗？就在前面。

say:4:1320323002:1.text: Chippy, man up! Just collect the dust with your eyes closed. I'll be right here to guide you.
say:4:1320323002:1.source_cn: 满满别怕，闭着眼睛收集就好，我会在旁边指导你的！

say:5:1320323003:1.text: Alright... Chippy can do this... Chippy is a brave knight...

say:7:1320323004:1.text: Your strength is impressive. I never expected defeating the oculus bat to be this easy.
say:7:1320323004:1.source_cn: 你的力量很强大。我从没想过战胜目蝠会是这么容易的一件事。

choice_prompt:15:1320323010.female: Yet now, I yearn for complete oblivion. It's a bitter irony, isn't it?

say:16:1320323011:1.text: Perhaps... I'm no longer the same Ludovic who once lived.
say:16:1320323011:1.source_cn: ……或许，我和曾经活着的那个柳博米尔，已经不是同一个人了。
say:16:1320323011:1.male: Perhaps... I'm no longer the same Ludovic who once lived.
say:16:1320323011:1.female: Perhaps... I'm no longer the same Ludovic who once lived.

say:18:1320323013:1.text: Magister, we've finished collecting all the dust!
say:18:1320323013:1.source_cn: 主人，我们收集完菌丝粉了！
say:18:1320323013:1.male: Magister, we've finished collecting all the dust!
say:18:1320323013:1.female: Magister, we've finished collecting all the dust!

say:19:1320323014:1.text: Ludovic, you seem down... Is something wrong?
say:19:1320323014:1.source_cn: 咦……？柳博米尔，你的表情怎么好像有点不对劲？出什么事了吗？

say:21:1320323016:1.text: Let's search for wood to make the frame. I know where the perfect tree is. Come along.
say:21:1320323016:1.source_cn: 去找制作画框的木材吧。我知道哪里有合适的树木，跟我来。

say:23:1320323012:1.text: I suppose that counts as one of the few positives...
say:23:1320323012:1.source_cn: 嗯，这算是为数不多的好事……
say:23:1320323012:1.male: I suppose that counts as one of the few positives...
say:23:1320323012:1.female: I suppose that counts as one of the few positives...

choice:15:1:2.text: You've at least met your past wishes.
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 至少你还能实现曾经的心愿
choice:15:1:2.male: You've at least met your past wishes.
choice:15:1:2.female: You've at least met your past wishes.

choice:8:0:1.text: I thought you often came to get materials.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 我还以为你会经常来收集原料呢
choice:8:0:1.male: I thought you often came to get materials.
choice:8:0:1.female: I thought you often came to get materials.

say:3:1320324002:1.text: Huh, is there something special about this tree? It doesn't look all that different to Chippy...
say:3:1320324002:1.source_cn: 唔，这棵树有什么特别的吗？满满觉得和其他树好像也没什么区别。

say:4:1320324003:1.text:
I planted it back when I was alive.
After I learned that my illness couldn't be cured, I came here to see if I could still bring life to something else.
say:4:1320324003:1.source_cn: 它是我生前种下的树。\n在我得知我的病无法痊愈后，就偷...

say:5:1320324004:1.text: I hoped that this tree would carry my hopes and thrive in my stead.
say:5:1320324004:1.source_cn: 那时的我想，即使我死去，这棵树也能承载着我的希望，不断...

say:6:1320324005:1.text: However, I never imagined I'd continue on in this form... Now, as it withers, here I am still.
say:6:1320324005:1.source_cn: 我从没想过，自己会变成现在的模样。用另一种方式永恒地活...

say:7:1320324006:1.text: I once buried a charm with my name beneath it, hoping it would protect the tree.
say:7:1320324006:1.source_cn: 我曾经将一个刻有名字的护符埋在了树下，希望它能庇佑这棵树。

say:8:1320324007:1.text: Now it's time to take it back.

say:0:1320325001:0.source_cn: 找到了，当年埋下的护符。

say:1:1320325002:0.text: Now, let's return to <style="highlight">Everstill Manor</style> and restore the painting.

say:3:1320326001:1.text: Thank you all for helping me gather these materials. Now, I can begin restoring the painting.
say:3:1320326001:1.source_cn: 多谢你们陪我找到这些材料。之后我要开始修复画作了。

say:6:1320326003:2.text: ...Hold on! Ludovic, why did you break it?!
say:6:1320326003:2.source_cn: ……等等！柳博米尔，你为什么要打碎它？！

say:7:1320326004:1.text: Because it's made of lapis lazuli.

say:8:1320326005:1.text: To keep the paint colors vibrant, I'll need lapis lazuli powder mixed with the dust we just collected.
say:8:1320326005:1.source_cn: 想要修复这幅画，必须在颜料中加入青金石粉末，这样才能在...

say:9:1320326006:1.text: But... isn't lapis lazuli super rare and valuable? Plus, this charm held your hopes from your past life.
say:9:1320326006:1.source_cn: 可是……青金石这么稀有的宝石很贵重，而且这个护符又承载...

say:10:1320326007:1.text: It feels like a pity to break it...
say:10:1320326007:1.source_cn: 就这样毁掉，是不是太可惜了？

choice_prompt:11:1320326007.text: It feels like a pity to break it...
choice_prompt:11:1320326007.source_cn: 就这样毁掉，是不是太可惜了？

say:12:1320326010:1.text: The person who buried the charm is long gone, and that chapter of life is completely closed. This charm... along with its intangible hopes, has lost all significance.
say:12:1320326010:1.source_cn: 埋下护符的人已经死了，那段生命中的一切都已经彻底结束。...

say:13:1320326011:1.text: Please leave the restoration to me. I kindly ask you to make another trip to Cedartown to <style="highlight">inform Levski</style> that I'm in the process of restoring his painting.
say:13:1320326011:1.source_cn: 修复工作交给我就好。劳烦你们再去一趟雪松镇，将这个消息...

say:14:1320326012:1.text: Tell him to be patient a little longer. Once it's restored, I will return it to him.
say:14:1320326012:1.source_cn: 请他再耐心等待一阵。等这幅画恢复原样，我会还给他的。

choice:11:0:1.text: He can decide what to do with it.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 他有权利决定如何处置自己的东西
choice:11:0:1.male: He can decide what to do with it.
choice:11:0:1.female: He can decide what to do with it.

say:16:1320326008:1.text: Wealth is meaningless for a Graveborn.
say:16:1320326008:1.source_cn: 对于亡灵来说，钱财不值一提。

say:17:1320326009:1.text: I want to make this painting look like it used to as quickly as possible.
say:17:1320326009:1.source_cn: 嗯。我只想尽快开始修复画作。

choice:11:2:3.text: It saves us the hassle of finding it!
choice:11:2:3.source_cn: 总好过让我们去找青金石！
choice:11:2:3.male: It saves us the hassle of finding it!
choice:11:2:3.female: It saves us the hassle of finding it!

say:2:1320327001:1.text: Hey, Levski! We've got a great news for you!
say:2:1320327001:1.source_cn: 列夫斯基，有个好消息要告诉你！

say:3:1320327002:1.text: Our friend is working on fixing your painting, and you'll get it back real soon!
say:3:1320327002:1.source_cn: 我们的朋友决定帮你修复那副被损坏的画，等恢复原样后就会...

say:4:1320327003:1.text: Oh, Dura above! Is... is that really true?! *Cough*
say:4:1320327003:1.source_cn: 这……这是真的吗？！艾雅在上……咳、咳咳——！

say:7:1320327004:1.text: Don't get too worked up! You need to stay calm!
say:7:1320327004:1.source_cn: 别——别激动！你要尽量保持心情平和才行！

say:8:1320327005:1.text: Ah, I'm just really happy; sorry about that...
say:8:1320327005:1.source_cn: 哈、哈哈……我只是太高兴了，抱歉……咳……

choice_prompt:9:1320327005.text: Ah, I'm just really happy; sorry about that...
choice_prompt:9:1320327005.source_cn: 哈、哈哈……我只是太高兴了，抱歉……咳……

say:10:1320327006:1.text: I get that you're thrilled, but your health is what matters most right now! How about I give you a quick health check-up?
say:10:1320327006:1.source_cn: 我能理解你的心情，但还是保重身体最要紧！不如，我再来帮...

say:11:1320327007:1.text: That would be great... to be honest, I can barely afford to go to the doctors... *Cough*
say:11:1320327007:1.source_cn: 那就麻烦了……实不相瞒，我已经快要看不起医生了，咳……

say:13:1320327009:1.text: How am I doing? Will my body last until the painting is fixed...?
say:13:1320327009:1.source_cn: 怎、怎么样？我的身体，能坚持到那幅画修好的时候吗……

say:14:1320327010:1.text: Don't worry... you're fine. Just make sure you rest and take your medication as directed!
say:14:1320327010:1.source_cn: ……放心吧……没什么大问题。只要你好好休息，按时吃药…...

say:15:1320327011:1.text: That's a relief... I think I'll take another nap... *Cough*
say:15:1320327011:1.source_cn: 那就好……我、我得再睡一觉……咳……

say:18:1320327012:1.text: Hammie... you seem worried. Is something up with Levski's health?
say:18:1320327012:1.source_cn: 漫漫……你的表情好凝重。是不是列夫斯基的身体……？

choice_prompt:19:1320327012.text: Hammie... you seem worried. Is something up with Levski's health?
choice_prompt:19:1320327012.source_cn: 漫漫……你的表情好凝重。是不是列夫斯基的身体……？

say:21:1320327015:1.text: At this point, no medication will make a difference, and he could go at any time...
say:21:1320327015:1.source_cn: 他的病已经深入骨髓，任何药都没用，随时可能死去……

say:22:1320327016:1.text: For now, we can only hope he stays positive; maybe that will help him hold on a little longer...
say:22:1320327016:1.source_cn: 现在只能寄希望于他能保持乐观的心态，或许能再多坚持一阵……

say:23:1320327017:1.text: Let's not just sit and wait! We need to hurry back to <style="highlight">Everstill Manor</style> and tell Ludovic to work faster!
say:23:1320327017:1.source_cn: 那……那我们别干等着了，赶快回<style=highl...

choice:19:1:2.text: He must be able to hang on, right?
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 他一定能坚持下去的，对吧？
choice:19:1:2.male: He must be able to hang on, right?
choice:19:1:2.female: He must be able to hang on, right?

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: （示意漫漫检查一下他的身体状况）

say:0:1320328001:0.text: Ludovic! We need to speak to you!

say:3:1320329001:1.text: Oh! Distinguished guests, I must ask you not to raise your voices within Everstill Manor!
say:3:1320329001:1.source_cn: 噢！尊贵的客人，请不要在永寂庄园内大呼小叫！

say:4:1320329002:1.text: As the name suggests, this place thrives on tranquility. His Lordship dislikes disturbances.
say:4:1320329002:1.source_cn: 正如它的名字那般，庄园需要保持安静。子爵先生不喜欢被——

say:5:1320329003:1.text: Please, Václav! We need to speak with Ludovic!
say:5:1320329003:1.source_cn: 瓦茨拉夫，我们有急事要找柳博米尔！

say:6:1320329004:1.text: Ahem, His Lordship is currently absorbed in restoring a painting, and there is nothing more pressing to him right now.
say:6:1320329004:1.source_cn: 咳，子爵先生正忙于修复画作，眼下没有比这更重要的事，还...

say:7:1320329005:1.text: We have news about the painter!
say:7:1320329005:1.source_cn: 我们要说的事就和那幅画——不对，和那幅画的画家有关！

choice_prompt:8:1320329005.text: We have news about the painter!
choice_prompt:8:1320329005.source_cn: 我们要说的事就和那幅画——不对，和那幅画的画家有关！

say:9:1320329006:1.text: Oh no! This is certainly a grave matter!

say:10:1320329007:1.text: His Lordship requires complete focus during his work; it would be inappropriate to disturb him at this moment...
say:10:1320329007:1.source_cn: 但子爵先生工作时需要集中精神，此时过去打扰实在是……

say:11:1320329008:1.text: Please, Václav! We must let Ludovic know this as soon as possible!
say:11:1320329008:1.source_cn: 拜托了，瓦茨拉夫！这件事必须尽早让柳博米尔知道！

say:12:1320329009:1.text: ...Very well, very well. I will convey your message to His Lordship, but whether he agrees to meet you depends on his discretion.
say:12:1320329009:1.source_cn: ……好吧，好吧。我会将诸位的话告知子爵先生，但是否与你...

say:13:1320329010:1.text: You are welcome to find ways to occupy yourselves in the manor while I return shortly.
say:13:1320329010:1.source_cn: 诸位可以在庄园内随意打发时间，我会尽快回来的。

choice:8:0:1.text: Levski doesn't have much time left.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 列夫斯基不久于人世了
choice:8:0:1.male: Levski doesn't have much time left.
choice:8:0:1.female: Levski doesn't have much time left.

choice:8:1:2.text: Levski may not hold on much longer.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 列夫斯基可能坚持不下去了
choice:8:1:2.male: Levski may not hold on much longer.
choice:8:1:2.female: Levski may not hold on much longer.

say:2:1320331001:1.text: Hmm? Aren't you the Flower Attendant we met earlier?
say:2:1320331001:1.source_cn: 咦？你是我们之前见到的那位奇花侍者吗？

say:3:1320331002:1.text: I think you have mistaken me for someone else. While you've been visiting Everstill Manor quite often lately, I've never spoken with you.
say:3:1320331002:1.source_cn: 我想应该不是。虽然诸位最近常来永寂庄园，但我从未与您搭过话。

say:4:1320331003:1.text: Oh, you do talk differently! The last attendant seemed rather timid!
say:4:1320331003:1.source_cn: 难怪你说话的语气不一样呢。之前那位侍者似乎很胆小！

say:5:1320331004:0.text: The timid flower attendant... Ah, you mean the one who organizes the painting tools.
say:5:1320331004:0.source_cn: 胆小的奇花侍者……啊，想必是几日前凋零的那位。

say:6:1320331005:0.text: He has been feeling a bit worn out lately, but don't worry, he's not near the point of withering yet.
say:6:1320331005:0.source_cn: 他最近有些疲惫，情绪也有些低落。但请不必担心，他还没有...

say:8:1320331007:0.text: Yes. Although His Lordship has granted us bodies and consciousness, we are still, at our core, everblooms. Even with prolonged life, withering remains the fate of every flower.
say:8:1320331007:0.source_cn: 是的。虽然子爵先生用魔法赋予了我们身躯与意识，但本质上...

say:9:1320331008:0.text: These are the words His Lordship told me, and I've done my best to remember them.
say:9:1320331008:0.source_cn: ——这些话是子爵先生告诉我的，我很努力才记下来。

say:10:1320331009:0.text: Strangely enough, His Lordship claims to envy us everblooms, believing that our eventual withering is something to be desired.
say:10:1320331009:0.source_cn: 不过，不知道为什么，子爵先生竟然说他很羡慕我们这些永寂...

say:11:1320331010:0.text: I still can't grasp that idea. His Lordship's thoughts are certainly quite intricate...
say:11:1320331010:0.source_cn: 这句话我到现在都没能理解。先生的想法总是很深奥……

say:2:1320332001:1.text: You! All of you! I heard you calling His Lordship by his name again!
say:2:1320332001:1.source_cn: 我听到了！你，你们！又在直呼子爵先生的姓名！

say:3:1320332002:1.text: You've already been granted a considerable privilege to be here! Yet you dare to speak his name directly! You should address him as "Lord" or "His Lordship"!
say:3:1320332002:1.source_cn: 你们应该称呼他为子爵先生！或者子爵阁下！

say:4:1320332003:1.text: Ludovic didn't mind! Why do you insist on correcting us?
say:4:1320332003:1.source_cn: ……他自己都不在意，你为什么非要纠正我们啊？

say:5:1320332004:1.text: Hmph! What could a hamster like you possibly know about noble pride?
say:5:1320332004:1.source_cn: 哼！小小仓鼠，哪里懂得贵族的荣耀！

say:6:1320332005:1.text: His Lordship's title isn't just for show!
say:6:1320332005:1.source_cn: 先生的子爵之位，可是独一无二的荣誉！

say:9:1320332006:1.text: Well, I'm sure earning the title of viscount at Ludovic's age is impressive, but...
say:9:1320332006:1.source_cn: 虽然以柳博米尔生前的年龄来说，他能获得子爵之位确实很厉...

say:10:1320332007:1.text: The word "impressive" doesn't even cover it! Let me tell you how His Lordship earned it!
say:10:1320332007:1.source_cn: 一点也不夸张！你们知道先生为什么会获得子爵之位吗？

say:11:1320332008:1.text: It was purely due to his wonderful artistic skills!
say:11:1320332008:1.source_cn: ——是因为先生在艺术方面的成就！！

say:12:1320332009:1.text: Not a single battle, not a single medal—just sheer, extraordinary talent!
say:12:1320332009:1.source_cn: 没有战绩，没有功勋，仅仅是因为先生高超的艺术造诣！你们...

say:13:1320332010:1.text: And trust me, that kind of honor isn't given to just anyone. In the entire Lightbearer Empire, His Lordship is the only one with such recognition! So yes, a little extra respect wouldn't kill you.
say:13:1320332010:1.source_cn: 即使是在整个耀光帝国，也只有先生获得过这般荣誉！所以每...

say:14:1320332011:1.text: Hey, wait, where are you going? I'm not finished yet!
say:14:1320332011:1.source_cn: 等等，你们别走——我还没说完！

say:0:1320333001:0.text: Dear guests, His Lordship will meet with you in the front courtyard.
say:0:1320333001:0.source_cn: 诸位客人，子爵先生将在前庭接见你们。

say:1:1320333002:0.text: Let's hurry over and tell him about Levski!
say:1:1320333002:0.source_cn: 太好了，我们快点过去吧！

say:3:1320335001:1.text: Oh, finally! Chippy's eyes are practically going cross-eyed from all the details!
say:3:1320335001:1.source_cn: 总算……总算将这幅画修复好了！满满的眼睛都要看花了！

say:4:1320335002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll need your help again to <style="highlight">return this to Levski</style>.
say:4:1320335002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll need your help again to <style="highlight">return this to Levski</style>.
say:4:1320335002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll need your help again to <style="highlight">return this to Levski</style>.

choice_prompt:5:1320335002.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll need your help again to <style="highlight">return this to Levski</style>.
choice_prompt:5:1320335002.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll need your help again to <style="highlight">return this to Levski</style>.

say:6:1320335003:0.text: It's best if Graveborn limit their contact with humans.
say:6:1320335003:0.source_cn: 亡灵还是不要和人类接触得太多比较好。
say:6:1320335003:0.male: It's best if Graveborn limit their contact with humans.
say:6:1320335003:0.female: It's best if Graveborn limit their contact with humans.

say:7:1320335004:1.text: But I'm sure Levski would like to meet the one who restored his masterpiece...
say:7:1320335004:1.source_cn: 但如果列夫斯基主动提出想见你一面，我们总不能一直拦着他吧？

say:8:1320335005:1.text: How about you wait outside Cedartown? That way, we can find you in no time! You know Levski's condition...
say:8:1320335005:1.source_cn: 不如你跟着我们一起过去，在雪松镇外等待？这样我们可以以...

say:9:1320335006:1.text: ...I understand. I'll wait for you outside Cedartown.
say:9:1320335006:1.source_cn: ……我明白了。我会在雪松镇外等你们的。

say:10:1320335007:1.text: I believe you should set off at your earliest convenience.

choice:5:0:1.text: Why don't you deliver it yourself?
choice:5:0:1.male: Why don't you deliver it yourself?
choice:5:0:1.female: Why don't you deliver it yourself?

choice:5:1:2.text: I'm sure he'd like to meet you.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我觉得他肯定很想见你一面
choice:5:1:2.male: I'm sure he'd like to meet you.
choice:5:1:2.female: I'm sure he'd like to meet you.

say:0:1320337001:0.text: Why isn't Levski at home? He couldn't have...
say:0:1320337001:0.source_cn: 列夫斯基怎么不在家里……？他该不会……

say:1:1320337002:0.text: No, that can't be... Let's ask his father!
say:1:1320337002:0.source_cn: 不，不会的……我们问问他父亲！

say:2:1320338001:1.text: Excuse me, do you know where Levski is?
say:2:1320338001:1.source_cn: 大叔！列夫斯基他……他去哪了？

say:3:1320338002:1.text: Oh, kind souls... thank you for keeping him in your thoughts. But he has... he has already...
say:3:1320338002:1.source_cn: 好心人……谢谢你们还惦记着他。但他已经……已经……

choice_prompt:4:1320338002.text: Oh, kind souls... thank you for keeping him in your thoughts. But he has... he has already...
choice_prompt:4:1320338002.source_cn: 好心人……谢谢你们还惦记着他。但他已经……已经……

say:5:1320338003:1.text: It was a miracle that Levski managed to hold on this long...

say:9:1320341007:1.text: You... how could you say something like that!

say:10:1320341008:1.source_cn: 哼，老叶甫根尼，我劝你早点认命。这些多管闲事的人早晚要...

say:8:1320344005:1.text: Five times... that's way too much! I can't accept that!
say:8:1320344005:1.source_cn: 五、五倍……这实在太多了！我不能收……！

say:9:1320344006:1.text: Look, even for Levski's sake, this painting isn't worth that much... I suppose I'll take three times its value, and that should be enough to help us pay off our debts and find a little peace.
say:9:1320344006:1.source_cn: 即使看在列夫斯基的份上，这幅画也不值这么多钱。我只拿三...

say:10:1320344007:1.text: Alright, three times it shall be.

say:11:1320344008:1.text: I can't thank you enough! You're truly a generous soul!
say:11:1320344008:1.source_cn: 谢谢……谢谢您！您真是一位好心人！

say:14:1320344009:1.text: This is great! Now, they won't have to deal with those annoying debt collectors anymore!
say:14:1320344009:1.source_cn: 太好了，他们一家总算不用为生存而担忧了。

say:15:1320344010:1.text: Ludovic, are you going to sprinkle a little preservation magic on this painting since you spent so much money buying it?
say:15:1320344010:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔，这幅画要怎么办？你花了那么多钱，要不要给它附...

say:16:1320344011:1.text: That will not be necessary. I intend to bring it back to Everstill Manor, where it shall gracefully decay until it is no more.
say:16:1320344011:1.source_cn: 不必了。我会把它带回永寂庄园，让它自然腐朽，直至完全消...

say:17:1320344012:1.text: After all... every entity in this world should have its own destined end.
say:17:1320344012:1.source_cn: 世上的一切……都应该有属于自己的时间尽头。
